stem:
In two moles of acetaldehyde \((\mathrm{CH_3CHO})\) calculate the following

a. Number of moles of carbon

b. Number of moles of hydrogen

c. Number of moles of oxygen

d. Number of molecules of acetaldehyde
bookAnswer: A. 4 mol, B. 8 mol, C. 2 mol, D. 12.044 x 10^23 molecules
